items.text: Frontend Engineer with 4.5 years of experience crafting fast, accessible web applications and scalable design systems using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS.

entries.heading: Frontend Engineer, Design Systems & Web Platform | Looma Studio | 2022 – Present

items.text: Built and shipped collaborative project workspace and real-time commenting web applications in React 18 and TypeScript serving 650,000 monthly active creators.
Architected and maintained the Prism design system of 42 reusable component primitives in Storybook backed by automated Style Dictionary Figma design tokens, adopted by 6 product squads.

Offloaded third-party telemetry to Web Workers, introduced route-level code splitting, and preloaded AVIF hero assets, shrinking initial JS payload from 480KB to 155KB and cutting 75th-percentile largest paint from 3.8s to 1.4s.
Led an end-to-end a11y remediation initiative to achieve WCAG 2.1 AA compliance across billing and workspace views, fixing modal focus traps, ARIA live regions, and VoiceOver/NVDA announcements.
Migrated legacy Redux thunks to TanStack Query (React Query) for client/server-state caching and GraphQL/REST data fetching, removing 4,200 lines of boilerplate.
Authored 95 Playwright multi-viewport user-journey specs and Chromatic pixel-diff checks running on every pull request, cutting production UI hotfixes by 68%.
Embedded in weekly critique sessions with interaction leads and user study facilitators to iterate on fluid layouts from early napkin sketches through general availability.
Onboarded 3 associate engineers through paired PR walkthroughs and enforced strict ESLint and TypeScript strictNullChecks across the frontend monorepo.
Migrated build tooling from Webpack 4 to Vite and Turborepo, reducing local dev server cold start from 28 seconds to 1.8 seconds.
Developed storefront product detail, filtering, and cart experiences in React and TypeScript for a multi-brand e-commerce platform.
Eliminated visual layout jumps during async price hydration by reserving CSS aspect-ratio skeleton boxes and virtualizing 5,000-row inventory tables with TanStack Virtual.
Implemented dark-mode theming using CSS custom properties and prefers-color-scheme media queries across 85 storefront screens.
Integrated Sentry client-side error boundaries and source-map uploads in GitHub Actions to surface uncaught runtime exceptions within 2 minutes of release.
Built responsive mobile-web checkout drawers and touch gesture carousels in React for iOS Safari and Android Chrome viewports.
Localized storefront copy, date/currency formatting, and RTL stylesheet mirroring across 7 European and Middle Eastern locales using react-intl.
Facilitated quarterly product discovery workshops using Miro and FigJam digital canvas boards.
Optimized inline SVG icon sprites and CSS three-column comparison tables for the enterprise pricing page.
Drafted reactive post-incident customer communication banners for the public system status page.
Organized biweekly browser-tab decluttering and developer ergonomics lightning talks for the remote engineering org.
Coordinated a swift rollback of edge CDN routing rules when a staging TLS certificate was inadvertently promoted.
